## Summary

The IEEE registry lists 19 MA-L blocks to Zhejiang Tmall Technology
Co., Ltd., some at the Ali Center on Keyuan South Road in Nanshan,
Shenzhen and the rest on Wenyi West Road, Yuhang District, Hangzhou
[1]. Tmall is the online marketplace Taobao launched in April 2008 and
Alibaba Group operates [3]. The best-known Tmall-branded hardware is the
Tmall Genie, a smart speaker developed by Alibaba around its AliGenie
assistant, launched in China on 8 August 2017, which handles music,
web search, home automation and shopping and is listed with 2.4 GHz
Wi-Fi and Bluetooth 4.0 [2]. No source consulted states that Tmall
Genie devices or the smart-home products they control carry these
blocks, so that reading is inferred and found_in and radios are left
empty [1][2].

NVD entries naming Tmall concern unrelated open-source shop demos, not
this registrant's devices, so no security notes are listed [1]. Silicon,
FCC grantee codes and randomisation are unknown: the FCC ID databases
and web search were unavailable to the session that wrote this entry,
and nothing is filled in from memory [1].
